title: 戒菸後 20 分鐘內的血壓改善
content: 研究指出，戒菸後 20 分鐘內，血壓與心率開始回落，這是身體開始擺脫尼古丁刺激的第一個明顯指標。

title: 12 小時內一氧化碳大幅下降
content: 戒菸 12 小時後，體內一氧化碳濃度明顯下降，血液中的氧氣運輸能力開始恢復。

title: 一年後心血管疾病風險降低
content: 臨床證據顯示，戒菸 1 年後，心肌梗塞和中風的風險顯著降低，心血管系統進入穩定期。

title: Blood pressure drops within 20 minutes
content: Medical sources note that within 20 minutes of quitting smoking, blood pressure and pulse begin to return to normal levels.

title: Carbon monoxide levels fall in 12 hours
content: After 12 hours without smoking, carbon monoxide levels sharply decrease and oxygen transport in the blood improves.

title: One year later, cardiovascular risk is lower
content: Evidence shows that one year after quitting smoking, the risk of heart disease and stroke drops significantly.

title: 戒烟 20 分钟后的生理变化
content: 临床资料显示，戒烟 20 分钟后，血压和心率开始趋于正常。

title: 禁煙後 20 分間の体の変化
content: 禁煙後 20 分で血圧と脈拍が低下し始めることが報告されています。

title: 금연 후 20분 내 신체 변화
content: 금연 후 20분 안에 혈압과 맥박이 감소하기 시작한다는 사실이 알려져 있습니다。

title: Health benefits start quickly after quitting
content: Quitting smoking brings rapid health improvements, including lower blood pressure and better oxygen delivery.
